api.impact: Native Save/Save As/Copy and permitted Photato local saves share destination visibility through AppKit staging. Existing download/job bytes and Adobe wire contracts remain unchanged. No Adobe host-file visibility route is invented.

remaining: All major workflow gates remain open; this increment repairs an observed save/publication defect, not complete file-workflow or Photoshop parity.

Feather kernels differ at all15 tested nonzero radii. Exact exploratory convolution fits at4/5/10 do not establish a general parameter-selection, precision or boundary rule. Small radii, other depths, vector/scaled/group masks remain unqualified.
Full source editability, fill opacity/effects/artboards/auxiliary channels and original .pcraft output remain unfinished.

Complete Photoshop menus, factory shortcuts/preferences, formats/colour/large-file workflows, on-device/PCC AI, distribution/IAP and remaining professional workflows still require implementation or qualification.
Both APIs remain supported interfaces with21 typed Photato commands, three partial Adobe endpoints and five unimplemented endpoints; broader compatibility is unfinished.
Rosetta tests are not physical Intel/macOS14 runtime qualification. Live UI used the frozen Debug object harness, not the packaged Release app.
External metadata changes after validation, full external coordination, parent-directory persistence and power-loss behavior are not guaranteed.
Minor functions and cosmetic details remain behind all major functions.
